document.abstract: This practice describes techniques for specifying jitter in self-clocking, bit-serial digital systems. It is applicable to sources, receivers, and regenerators. It is specifically intended for, but not limited to, ANSI/SMPTE 259M serial systems. Methods for measuring these specifications are found in SMPTE RP 192.
